summary: Upcoming public holidays for your country, or any country by its two-letter code.
notes: Reads the free Nager.Date API on date.nager.at. Settings › Extensions › Preferences picks the country (United States by default; Volant 0.3.22 and later). Type a name to filter, or a code first, such as de or fr noël, for another country. Dates count from today in UTC. Return opens the country's year on nagerholidays.com. Not affiliated with Nager.Date.
